items.title: Nisikhola flood-displaced move to relatives’ homes with resettlement uncertain

items.desc: The party is expanding its leadership structure and introducing reserved positions to give Gen Z and other underrepresented groups a greater voice.

items.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked pilot with axe in attempted ‘terrorist attack’, UAE says
items.desc: While Emirati authorities and the airline have not publicly identified the co-pilot, Israeli officials have previously said he is an ​Omani national. Oman has not commented on the incident.

items.title: British Gurkha veterans issue ultimatum to Nepal government over long-standing grievances
items.desc: The veterans’ committee has set a December 31, 2026, deadline for progress on pay, pensions, recognition and other demands, warning it will resume protests and hunger strikes in Nepal and the UK if no agreement is reached.

items.title: Government prefers lower house over upper for bill registration
items.desc: With no representation in the National Assembly, the government registered 21 of its 23 bills in the House of Representatives during the current fiscal year.

items.title: Nepse slips below 2,600 as selling pressure broadens

items.title: Prime Minister Balendra Shah largely absent as Parliament wraps up session
items.desc: Shah attended the House of Representatives for just six days and the National Assembly once, while lawmakers repeatedly sought his answers on issues ranging from floods and border disputes to foreign policy.

items.title: Hundreds from India’s Gen Z-led ‘cockroach’ party protest, seek election chief’s resignation

items.desc: After four years of being watched, India’s departing ambassador to Nepal spent his final weeks birdwatching.

items.title: How inactivity and excess weight can shape cancer risk

items.title: Ministers pledge legal reforms ahead of Nepal infrastructure summit

items.title: 12 laws passed, 35 bills registered as budget session ends

items.title: Congress to raise office-bearer positions to 21 to include Gen Z, women

items.desc: Hundreds of under-35 representatives, including a growing number of Gen Z delegates, are seeking a bigger role in the party after last year’s youth-led movement.

items.title: Foreign delegates arriving for Congress convention
items.desc: The inaugural event not expected to see a big number of political representatives from abroad, allegedly due to the disasters that struck Nepal recently.

items.title: From Juddha Shumsher’s speech to Malla-era manuscripts, 800 historical documents return to Nepal
items.desc: The collection, spanning the 13th to 20th centuries, includes royal edicts, legal records, court documents, manuscripts, and travel diaries.

items.title: Kathmandu deploys 3,500 police for Dashain, Tihar and Chhath
items.desc: Police will step up patrols and surveillance in crowded and sensitive areas, using CCTV cameras, drones and sniffer dogs to prevent theft, robbery and other festival-related crimes.

items.title: The children left behind by Nepal’s deadliest floods
items.desc: The Post spoke to 12 children from the flood-affected areas and gathered their experiences and the nightmares that still follow them.

items.title: Floods drive 33 pregnant women to Kathmandu for childbirth
items.desc: Local maternity clinics and services remain disrupted in Rasuwa and Nuwakot since the August 26 floods. But many women cannot travel to Kathmandu because of damaged roads.

items.title: Nepal’s squad announced for CWC League-2 tri-series with Canada in Oman
